steps.message: I’ll replace the fallback-to-snapshot behavior with a strict authoritative recheck. The provider will receive only the initial body and run before the transaction; inside the transaction I’ll lock/recheck the document, then lock the document/version embedding and update only when its stored revision is not newer. This keeps versions independent and prevents an older job from replacing a newer result.

# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class EmbeddingJob
    def call(document_id:, tenant_id:, version:, provider:)
      snapshot = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
      return :discarded unless snapshot

      # Keep the provider call outside the transaction. Apart from avoiding a
      # long-lived database transaction, this makes the values being embedded
      # explicit: they are the values from the initially authorized snapshot.
      body = snapshot.body
      revision = snapshot.revision
      vector = provider.call(body)

      Document.transaction do
        # Do not fall back to the original record here. It may have been
        # withdrawn, deleted, moved to another tenant, or revised while the
        # provider was running.
        current = Document.lock.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
        next :discarded unless current && current.revision == revision

        embedding = Embedding.lock.find_by(document_id: document_id, version: version)
        if embedding.nil?
          Embedding.create!(document_id: document_id, tenant_id: current.tenant_id,
                            revision: current.revision, version: version,
                            vector: JSON.generate(vector))
        elsif embedding.revision <= current.revision
          # A retry for the same version may refresh an older result, but an
          # older provider result must never replace a newer one.
          embedding.update!(tenant_id: current.tenant_id, revision: current.revision,
                            vector: JSON.generate(vector))
        end

        :stored
      end
    end
  end
end
